**Marcus Aurelius — Meditations IX.24**  
<sub>George Long translation · <a href="reading-317.md" aria-label="Previous reading">←</a> Reading 318 of 437 <a href="reading-319.md" aria-label="Next reading">→</a></sub>

> 24\. Quarrels of little children and their sports, and poor spirits
> carrying about dead bodies \[such is everything\]; and so what is
> exhibited in the representation of the mansions of the dead\[A\] strikes
> our eyes more clearly\.
> 


<details>
<summary>Translator notes</summary>
